verdict.rationale:
Postman publishes a comprehensive, documented public REST API (Postman API) for programmatically managing collections, workspaces, and other assets, confirmed by an OpenAPI spec at postman.com/openapi.json and explicit docs on integrating it into toolchains/CI/CD. This directly satisfies the ai-native 'drive via documented public API' story.

missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of API usage in the evidence pack beyond vendor docs and the openapi probe.
